items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The transcript only contains the Interviewer mentioning 'Joe (Riley?)' as a manager in a band the Interviewee was in. The Interviewee does not respond or confirm any personal interaction.

ctx.x: When you were out there in Chicago with Red, who was in that band?
(HUMS) Joe (Riley?); he was the manager. he's dead; Al Winters.
